description: Granular sample player: short looping grains are spawned from one position in a loaded sample and pile up into a cloud

params.text: Sets how long each grain is, from a five hundredth of a second to half a second
Attenuates the LENGTH CV, from nothing through to its full range
Sets how many grains may sound at once, up to 120, with the oldest removed as the count is passed
Attenuates the QUOTA CV, from nothing through to its full range
Sets how many grains are spawned each second, from 10 to 500
Attenuates the SPAWN CV, from nothing through to its full range
Sets where in the sample new grains begin, from its start to its end
Attenuates the playback position CV, from nothing through to its full range
Shifts the playback speed of every grain by a volt per octave, from -2V to 2V
Silences every grain sounding at that moment, leaving new ones to spawn
Sets the output level, from silence through unity at the centre to twice the level
Scatters the start position of each new grain over a range of about a thousand samples either way

inputs.text: A rising edge silences every grain sounding at that moment
Above 0V the start position of each new grain is scattered, and the switch is then ignored
Adds to the grain length after its attenuator, 0-10V covering its full range
Adds to the grain count after its attenuator, 0-10V covering none to 120
Adds to the spawn rate after its attenuator, 0-10V covering its full range
Adds to the playback position after its attenuator, 0-10V covering the whole sample
Adds to the playback speed, a volt per octave

outputs.text: The left channel of the grain cloud
The right channel of the grain cloud

notes: the outputs stay silent until a WAV file is loaded: right-click the panel and click the item under the Sample label, which reads [ EMPTY ] until then
menu: Sample — the item under this label loads the WAV file the grains are cut from, and prints the filename it holds
Remove Sample — empties the sample slot and silences every grain sounding at that moment

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.4:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.5:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.6: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
